text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hmmm. ♪ Hm, hmmm. ♪ Okay, all polished up.

text_block_list.text: Indeed. I've poured my thoughts and prayers for victory into polishing them up until they sparkle. ♪

text_block_list.text: The last race was disappointing, so this time I want to do everything I can to prepare.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: We've trained so intensely to prepare for this day. The rest depends on my resolve, right?
